February 12, 1971
2014-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/february-12-1971-55345

Cautioning Pakistan, Indian Prime Minister Indira Gandhi at an election rally in Maharashtra, says it may turn in a conflicting situation if Pakistan government does not compensate the destroyed aircraft and handover the two hijackers to India.

Pakistan People’s Party Chairman Zulfikar Ali Bhutto at a press meet at Karachi Airport says his party is trying wholeheartedly to overcome the crisis regarding the governance policy, the nation is going through.

Reacting to Pakistan People’s Party Chairman Zulfikar Ali Bhutto’s remark that if the governance policy is formulated on the basis of 6-point demand he would start a movement against it, Noor-e-Alam Siddiqui, president of East Pakistan Chhatra League, Shahjahan Siraj, general secretary, ASM Abdur Rab, vice-president of DAKSU and general secretary Abdul Kuddus Makhon in a joint statement say, his comment is not only sad but also against the main principle of democracy during such critical time of the country. Last election was the people’s mandate to write the governance policy on the basis of 6-point.
